narrationTexts: Fixing both real bugs: `options.js` reads `retries` but the bumped bundler passes `retryCount`, and `retryPolicy.js` throws on `undefined` instead of treating it as disabled.
finalText:
**Build's clean now.** Exit 0, 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump:

- [src/core/options.js](src/core/options.js) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw on `undefined.toFixed`.
- [src/net/retryPolicy.js](src/net/retryPolicy.js) treated unset `backoffEnabled` as invalid instead of `false`. New config loader leaves it `undefined`, not `false`.

The rest were deprecation noise from the bump, harmless.

Next: nothing.
